title: Neural Fourier Surrogates for Data Reuploading Quantum Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.00841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For quantum machine learning, the exact boundary between classical and quantum advantage is still poorly understood. Direct comparison between quantum neural networks (QNNs) and existing classical models, which encompass fundamentally different function classes, often fails to provide broader insight into the difference between the two. Inspired by the techniques of Neural Quantum States and Random Fourier Features, this work introduces Neural Fourier Surrogates (NFS), a stochastic classical neural network architecture for efficiently learning coefficients over the same finite Fourier series support as quantum neural networks. translated_title: 面向数据重上传量子神经网络的神经傅里叶代理模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.00841v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在量子机器学习领域，经典计算与量子计算优势之间的确切边界仍然知之甚少。由于量子神经网络（QNNs）与现有经典模型包含根本不同的函数类，对两者进行直接比较往往无法为它们之间的差异提供更广泛的洞察。受神经量子态和随机傅里叶特征技术的启发，本工作提出了神经傅里叶代理模型（NFS），这是一种随机经典神经网络架构，能够在与量子神经网络相同的有限傅里叶级数支撑上高效地学习系数。在一系列表格基准数据集上的测试表明，NFS是一种有效的分类器架构，与既有的经典基线模型（包括可比较的随机傅里叶特征模型）具有广泛的竞争力，并且其性能可与数据重上传量子神经网络相媲美；结合额外的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本工作提出神经傅里叶代理模型（NFS），一种能在与数据重上传量子神经网络相同的有限傅里叶级数支撑上学习系数的经典随机神经网络架构，在表格分类任务上达到了与量子神经网络及经典基线模型相媲美的性能。
en_tdlr: This work introduces Neural Fourier Surrogates (NFS), a stochastic classical neural network architecture that efficiently learns coefficients over the same finite Fourier series support as data reuploading quantum neural networks, achieving performance competitive with both QNNs and established classical baselines on tabular classification tasks.
